title: Everyday Knowledge Across Diverse Languages and Cultures (BLEnD)
description: SemEval-2026 Task 7: evaluating everyday cultural knowledge across diverse languages and cultures, built on the BLEnD benchmark. Annotators answer culturally grounded everyday-knowledge questions (e.g. common foods, customs, celebrations) for a given country/region. Two subtasks: Short Answer Questions (SAQ) and Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQ), covering many languages including low-resource ones.
paperReference: Ousidhoum et al., SemEval 2026 (Task 7); built on BLEnD (Myung et al., NeurIPS 2024)
